news.title: T.J. Hockenson (wrist) limited in practice Thursday

news.contents: Minnesota Vikings tight end T.J. Hockenson (wrist) was listed as a limited participant in practice for the second straight day on Thursday. Hockenson did not play in Sunday's Week 10 win over the division-rival Green Bay Packers due to wrist and chest injuries, but he has ditched the chest designation and is on track to make his return in Mexico City on Sunday night in a showdown against the San Francisco 49ers.
